title: Mystic Sorceress with Birds and Flowers
description: A woman in a dark hooded robe stands with arms outstretched, her face pale with a neutral expression. Her hands are open with one releasing glowing particles and the other near floating marks and runes, while birds fly around her, flowers grow from the cracked dark ground, and two glowing orbs with small scenes sit on either side. The setting shows ruined stone towers under a dramatic sky filled with colorful swirling clouds, a large eye symbol, and a cracked full moon.
prompt: A woman in a long dark blue hooded robe stands centered with arms outstretched, her face pale and neutral. Birds fly around her as colorful flowers grow from the cracked dark rocky ground at her feet. Two glowing orbs sit on the ground to her sides. In the background are ruined stone towers beneath a dramatic sky with swirling colorful clouds, a large cosmic eye, and a cracked full moon. Paint marks and runes are visible floating in the air.
